title: RepositoryHarnessManifest
description: Schema for docs/harness/manifest.json. Every check add-on entry follows a uniform shape — { description, enabled, severity, messages, parameters }. metadata entries (seedFiles, generatedArtifacts, harnessEvolution, teamPatterns) carry description + data and are not validated by the harness. The harness is not versioned; the current committed manifest is the only authoritative shape. Unknown top-level keys are logged as WARN by the validator's main routine (no separate add-on entry). The docContent add-on supports nested condition/when expressions inside parameters.checks using allOf, anyOf, contains, and not while preserving the uniform add-on shape.

addOn.description: Uniform shape for every check add-on. `parameters` is free-form per add-on; `messages` maps named template keys to user-visible failure messages.

metadata.description: Informational metadata; not validated by the harness.
